{{Quote|I'm glad you're on this. Now I know it will work out. The kidnapper fled the city, taking the Moff's nephew Zim with him. Getting Zim back safely is your highest priority. if his captor happens to die during the rescue, no one will shed any tears.|Jaleela Bindoo to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Zim Graedler''' was the nephew of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Graedler]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] was kidnapped, but soon rescued by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Jaleela Bindoo]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempArtisan.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Zim Graedler]]
Zim Graedler was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
